code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    color=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,9))
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    # use the smallest bounding pattern occupied by the colored object
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells}; sh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
      for c in range(w-sw+1):
        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
          for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out
'''
